name: Vital Spellstrike
body:
You only require a single swing to devastate foes with magic.

Prerequisite(s): Vital Magic, spellstrike class feature, character level 7th.

Benefit(s): You can use the spellstrike class feature while using Vital Magic as well as removing the -2 penalty on attack rolls when using spell combat.

Legendary Races: Wyrmtouched © 2018, Legendary Games; Authors: N. Jolly, Amber Underwood, Siobhan Bjorknas, and Loren Sieg.
